title: How retriever redundancy and diversity impact RAG effectiveness
abstract: arXiv:2608.13956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In RAG, while the retriever typically ranks documents by their individual relevance to the query, the generator instead produces an answer based on the retrieved documents as a whole. This paper investigates how redundancy and diversity from the retrieved document set impact the generator in terms of answer correctness.   Previous work has provided a mix of findings: some showing that redundancy improves generation by reinforcing relevant information, others that LLM-based paraphrasing of the same content may be beneficial. Many of these studies did not control for confounding factors like whether the documents contained the exact answer or not, and if parametric knowledge plays a role. translated_title: 检索器的冗余性与多样性如何影响RAG的有效性
translated_abstract: 在RAG（检索增强生成）中，检索器通常根据文档与查询的个体相关性对文档进行排序，而生成器则基于检索到的文档整体生成答案。本文研究了检索文档集中的冗余性和多样性如何影响生成器的答案正确性。以往研究提供了混合的发现：一些研究表明冗余通过强化相关信息改善了生成，另一些则表明基于LLM的同内容改写可能有益。许多这些研究未能控制混杂因素，如文档是否包含确切答案，以及参数化知识是否起作用。我们进行了一项精心控制的实验，研究了检索文档集的三个关键场景：1）重复（同一文档的精确副本），2）改写（一个文档的LLM改写版本），以及3）多样（来自不同来源的文档）。
tldr: 本文通过控制实验揭示，检索文档集中的冗余性（重复或改写）通常比多样性更能提升RAG生成的答案正确性，但前提是文档包含相关答案。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through controlled experiments that redundancy (duplicates or paraphrases) in retrieved document sets generally improves RAG answer correctness more than diversity, provided the documents contain relevant answers.
